heldOutPositives._why: Answers EXIST for these, but the wording deliberately avoids corpus vocabulary. The main positives are labelled BY full-text search, so any FTS-dependent rule scores 100% recall on them BY CONSTRUCTION. This set breaks that circularity: measured 0% recall for both 'fts>0' and 'vec<=0.60 AND fts>0', which is why neither actually passes.
